The issuer shows moderate profitability (net margin ~10% and EBIT margin ~8%) and decent near-term liquidity (current ratio ~1.75). Leverage appears manageable with total liabilities of 2,528M versus shareholders’ equity of 3,435M, but asset returns are only moderate (ROA ~3.5%), limiting the rating to the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB+
